title: Experts disagree on plugins/discovery/build/build.py
context:
Chief architect: All three agree. Extending build.py in place is the lead and matches the settled scope; the Python unit tests for each new flag and the golden comparison of the non-Claude outputs against a pre-change build both stay as the proof.

Target: plugins/discovery/build/build.py
- application-architect: is extended in place (--publish-prefix, --host-labels, --version, reusing rewrite_skill_md) rather than ported or re-implemented in TypeScript; the default flags keep the ChatGPT, ChatGPT directory and Codex outputs byte-identical apart from the version
- qa-engineer: New flags need Python unit tests: --publish-prefix none maps paqad-X to X and the front door paqad to start; --publish-prefix paqad keeps today's names; --host-labels strip removes the Decision 9 prefixes and compatibility for chatgpt, chatgpt-directory and codex; --version defaults to package.json.
- qa-engineer: Regression: the chatgpt, chatgpt-directory and codex outputs must match today's content apart from the version; a golden comparison against a pre-change build is the cheapest proof that strip really restores vendor-neutral text.
